# Command line

[[toc]]

```bash
npm install --save-dev @formknit/cli
```

## Check a schema

```bash
npx formknit check forms/admission.json
```

```
forms/admission.json: 1 error, 1 warning
  error    total: Circular reference: total → tax → total
  warning  country: Select field has no options
```

It exits with 1 when there are errors, so it can guard a commit or a build. Warnings alone
exit with 0.

## Generate types

For forms stored as JSON, generate the type of their data:

```bash
npx formknit types forms/admission.json -o src/types/admission.ts
```

```ts
// Generated by formknit. Do not edit by hand; regenerate when the form changes.
export interface AdmissionForm {
  /** Full name */
  fullName: string
  country: "NP" | "IN" | ''
  items: {
    name: string
    qty: number | null
  }[]
}
```

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `-o`, `--out <file>` | Write to a file instead of the screen |
| `-n`, `--name <Name>` | Type name. Defaults to the form's title |

Fields that can be hidden are listed as always present, but a hidden field is absent from a
submission. Treat conditional fields as possibly undefined when reading stored data.

Forms written with the [code-first builders](./defining-forms#in-code) do not need this; use
`InferData<typeof form>` instead.
